# serverguard24_downtime (Resource)

Manages a Serverguard24 maintenance window (downtime). **Note:** The API does not support editing or deleting downtimes. Any change forces recreation. Import sets only the downtime `id`; add all other attributes to config and run `terraform apply` to complete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "serverguard24_downtime" "maintenance" {
  hostname    = serverguard24_host.web.name
  start_time  = "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
  end_time    = "2026-04-01T02:00:00Z"
  description = "Scheduled maintenance window"

  services = [serverguard24_check.http.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the maintenance window.
- `end_time` (String) End of the maintenance window in RFC 3339 format (e.g. `2026-04-01T02:00:00Z`). Maximum duration is 23:59:59.
- `hostname` (String) Name of the host this maintenance window applies to.
- `start_time` (String) Start of the maintenance window in RFC 3339 format (e.g. `2026-04-01T00:00:00Z`).

### Optional

- `hosts` (List of String) List of host IDs to suppress alerts for during this maintenance window. Accepts string IDs so you can reference `serverguard24_host.example.id` directly.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Mark the maintenance window as read-only in the Serverguard24 UI.
- `services` (List of String) List of check IDs to suppress alerts for during this maintenance window. Accepts string IDs so you can reference `serverguard24_check.example.id` directly.
- `type` (String) Maintenance window type. Currently only `maintenance` is supported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
